subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of V. Only I sits to the right of U. Only three people sit between U and W. J sits at some place to the left of K but at some place to the right of L. How many people sit between L and K?
solution:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, U, V, and W, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only three people sit to the left of V.
 
• Only I sits to the right of U.
 
• Only three people sit between U and W.
 
• J sits at some place to the left of K but at some place to the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a16bfaa23ef416b892d764863156e10c44bc9db14cdf72013b8ab92a81e661ce.png]
